rawContent: All those questioning why women don’t speak up earlier, here’s a survivor’s tale. #standwithmetoo #metoo #respectsurvivorsrights
14 survivors’ stories discredited because well, the accused says “I did not do anything.” Suggestion: DO SOMETHING, prove your innocence rather than questioning the victims. #MeToo

It’s not a Left Vs Right battle, as was the foundation of the @republic debate tonight. What many of us-impartial supporters- are hoping from this historic legal battle is that it will trigger a domino effect that will bring all perpetrators to justice. #MeToo #standwithsuvivors

Just shows how rampant the lack of empathy is. Please note the watering down of a serious crime as “trouble”.  No one assumes guilt until proven but when you resort to diminishing accounts saying hey there is something “more important” than this, one begins to wonder... #MeToo
